examples.en: Of course we want to go back some day—it's our country, our real home.
examples.zh: 我们当然希望有一天能回去—那是我们的祖国，我们真正的家。

examples.en: Revising for exams gives you a chance to bring together all the individual parts of the course.
examples.zh: 考前复习给你一个把课程各独立部分融会贯通的机会。

examples.en: The course is an exciting opportunity for anyone wishing to deepen their understanding of themselves and other people.
examples.zh: 这门课程对于希望加深了解自己和他人的人们来说，是个令人兴奋的机会。
